:::

Charles Costanzo (he/him/his) is a third-year Ph.D. student in the Department of Statistics. His research interests include Bayesian statistics, statistical network models, and applications of statistical methods to social science and public policy. He earned his B.S. in Political Science and Statistics from The Ohio State University in 2024, graduating with honors research distinction in Political Science.

When not coding in R or cooking up a cool data visualization, you can probably find Charles scoping out a new coffee spot, catching a movie at his local theater, or lounging on the shores of a lake.
